name: @base/api-spec
description: HTTP and event contracts in TypeSpec — the source the OpenAPI document (api/openapi3), the event JSON Schemas (api/jsonschema) and the TS types (@base/contracts) are generated from. Holds its own TypeScript 6: openapi-typescript prints the types through the TypeScript compiler API, which TypeScript 7 (native) no longer ships; the rest of the workspace typechecks with 7.
